pages.title: A plan for today
pages.instruction: Listen for the problem, the response and the next step

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: It’s sunny today. Let’s go to the park
lines.audioText: It’s sunny today. Let’s go to the park.
lines.translation: Está ensolarado hoje. Vamos ao parque

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Good idea! What time can we meet?
lines.audioText: Good idea! What time can we meet?
lines.translation: Boa ideia! Que horas podemos nos encontrar?

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: At ten, near the station. Is that OK?
lines.audioText: At ten, near the station. Is that OK?
lines.translation: Às dez, perto da estação. Tudo bem?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Yes. Is there a café in the park?
lines.audioText: Yes. Is there a café in the park?
lines.translation: Sim. Tem um café no parque?

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: There is. We can have lunch there. Bring your ticket
lines.audioText: There is. We can have lunch there. Bring your ticket.
lines.translation: Tem. Podemos almoçar lá. Traga sua passagem

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Great. I’ll see you near the station at ten
lines.audioText: Great. I’ll see you near the station at ten.
lines.translation: Ótimo. Vejo você perto da estação às dez

questions.prompt: Where and when do the friends first agree to meet?
questions.hint: They agree to meet near … at …
questions.answer: They first agree to meet near the station at ten

questions.prompt: Why does Kim suggest the park?
questions.answer: Kim suggests the park because it’s sunny

questions.prompt: What does Kim tell Ana to bring?
questions.answer: Kim tells Ana to bring her ticket

pages.title: Rain changes our plan
pages.instruction: Listen for the new information and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hi, Ana! It’s raining near the park now. Let’s go to the museum today. Meet me at the museum entrance at ten, not at the station. We can take the bus. Bring your ticket. There’s a café inside. See you at ten!
pages.audioText: Hi, Ana! It’s raining near the park now. Let’s go to the museum today. Meet me at the museum entrance at ten, not at the station. We can take the bus. Bring your ticket. There’s a café inside. See you at ten!
